overview: HR Residency 2 is a professional Hotel Guest Management System with a premium Red & White luxury theme. It features a secure admin panel, comprehensive guest records with ID image uploads, a live dashboard with metrics and payment tracking, guest search/filter/pagination, soft delete with trash recovery, and mobile-responsive design.
features: Secure admin login with protected routes
Dashboard with guest metrics, revenue tracking, and payment breakdown chart
Add/Edit guest form with 19 fields including ID image upload
Guest database with real-time search and pagination
Stable persistent storage — data survives refresh and redeployment
Mobile-responsive Red & White luxury hotel theme
